name: Mode field
summary: A labelled field with an inline exclusive mode control whose body swaps in place — the settings field for a control that has two-or-more mutually-exclusive modes.
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-mode-field> — for a setting whose control has two-or-more EXCLUSIVE modes (an automatic/manual switch, a value-source switch): a head row with the label LEFT and the inline mode control RIGHT (wraps below on narrow), and a body that swaps IN PLACE as the active value changes. The bodies are the element's own light-DOM children (persistent nodes) tagged `data-mode`; switching only toggles their `hidden`, never rebuilds them — so the active body keeps its state and the mode buttons' transition fires. `variant` picks the look: `radio` (default) is an OUTLINE segmented control (selected = brand border + brand text on a WHITE/transparent fill — never a solid brand-filled pill); `segmented` is the neutral grey segmented control. `labelVariant` is `field` (regular weight) or `section` (semibold header for a grouped-list body); `help` adds the settings-label "?" tooltip. The mode buttons are an honest group of aria-pressed buttons (exclusive selection without faking a roving radiogroup). Shadow-DOM CSS, themed only by --aha-* tokens. Emits composed `change` CustomEvent<{value}>.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. Options are set as a property (`el.options = [...]`) or a JSON `options` attribute; bodies are light-DOM children with `data-mode`. `value`/`options` are the reference names; `mode`/`modes` remain as back-compat aliases and `change.detail` carries both. React (< 19) via a thin ref wrapper; Vue binds natively.

spec.label: Head
spec.value: label LEFT / mode control RIGHT on one row; gap 12, wraps (row-gap 8) on narrow; 32 min-height

spec.label: Radio variant (default)
spec.value: OUTLINE segmented, 32 high, semibold 13; selected = #6A1EBB border + #6A1EBB text on WHITE fill (no tint pill)

spec.label: Segmented variant
spec.value: neutral grey control — #F7F7F7 track, secondary-grey labels, active = white raised on default-text

spec.label: Label variant
spec.value: field = regular 400; section = semibold 600 (a header for a grouped-list body)

spec.label: Help
spec.value: optional "?" tooltip (system-question-mark) after the label when `help` is set; opens below (bottom-start) so it clears the panel top, and the bubble wraps within 240px

spec.label: Body
spec.value: the active value's light-DOM child; others hidden in place (persistent, keep state); margin-top 12; de-emphasised help text — secondary #4A4A4A, 13/20, regular — so the label stays the field's primary line

spec.label: Hover
spec.value: #D3B4FF border + #6A1EBB label on a radio-variant button

props.name: label
props.desc: The field label, left of the mode control

props.name: options
props.desc: The exclusive modes; set as a property or a JSON attribute (alias: modes)

props.name: variant
props.desc: radio = outline segmented (brand border, white fill); segmented = neutral grey

props.name: labelVariant
props.desc: field = regular weight; section = semibold header for a grouped-list body (attr: label-variant)

props.name: help
props.desc: When set, a "?" tooltip after the label (icon system-question-mark)

props.name: change
props.desc: Composed event on change; read e.detail.value (e.detail.mode is a back-compat alias)

whenToUse.when: a single setting whose control has 2+ exclusive modes and a mode-specific body (automatic vs manual, value-source A vs B)
an exclusive choice with NO mode-specific body to swap
a plain immediate on/off with no modes

opinion.note: Only the active value's body is live — the others stay in the DOM (persistent) but hidden, so switching back restores their state. Default `variant='radio'` is an OUTLINE segmented control (brand border + brand text on white); a solid brand-filled pill is NOT the mode-field look — pick `variant='segmented'` for the neutral grey alternative. A mode toggle for an action may keep a verb-led label ('Show results manually') per SETTINGS-01.
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — the settings-lab ModeField control mapped into the DS. The radio-outline + grey-segmented mode controls reuse the DS V3 segmented family; the label + inline-mode head row (with the optional "?" help tooltip), the field/section label weight, and the swap-in-place persistent body are the settings-specific shape.
